# Mascot v2 Concepts (Set B)

## Overview
This directory contains image-generated pixel-art mascot concepts created for OnniCode according to `mascot-v2-brief.md`.

All concepts were generated using generative image models targeting a high-resolution 64x64-aesthetic chibi sprite style, clean 1px dark outlines, brand colors (Navy `#0A1A2F`, Azure `#0B6BFF`, Sky `#5CA8FF`, White, and Amber `#FFB020` accent), the Onni `<` chevron motif, and a solid flat magenta `#FF00FF` background for clean chroma keying.

---

## Generated Files
- `concept-1.png`: Cyber Kitsune (Robot Fox Companion) — Hero Idle Pose
- `concept-2.png`: Cyber Neko (Robot Cat Companion) — Hero Idle Pose
- `concept-3.png`: Cyber Fennec Scout (Robot Fennec/Red Panda) — Hero Idle Pose
- `sheet.png`: 5-Pose Sprite Sheet for Concept 1 (Idle, Working, Success, Error, Sleep)

## Concept Details & Prompts Used

### Concept 1: Cyber Kitsune (Robot Fox Companion) — `concept-1.png`
- **Character Design**: A friendly chibi robotic kitsune / fox companion. Big head, kawaii chibi proportions, large expressive shiny amber (`#FFB020`) eyes. Mechanical fox ears with subtle glowing inner sensors, fluffy segmented robotic tail with azure glowing tip. White face and belly, navy blue (`#0A1A2F`) and azure (`#0B6BFF`) robotic body armor panels with sky blue (`#5CA8FF`) joints.
- **Logo Motif**: Glowing azure `<` chevron badge on its chest collar.
- **Pose**: Hero idle front-facing centered pose, smiling warmly, gentle welcoming posture.
- **Prompt**:
  > `Generate a cute chibi pixel art mascot of a friendly robotic fox companion ("Onni"). Style and specs: High resolution cute chibi pixel art sprite style (64x64 sprite aesthetic), clean 1px dark outline, crisp hard pixels, no anti-aliasing, no text, no blur, no gradients. Character: A lovable robotic baby kitsune / fox companion. Big head, kawaii chibi proportions, large expressive shiny amber (#FFB020) eyes. Mechanical fox ears with subtle glowing inner sensors. Fluffy robotic tail with azure tip. White face and belly, navy blue (#0A1A2F) and azure (#0B6BFF) robotic body panels with sky blue (#5CA8FF) joints. Logo motif: A small glowing azure '<' chevron badge on its chest collar. Pose: Hero idle front-facing pose, standing centered, smiling warmly and cutely, one paw giving a gentle friendly wave. Background: Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background for clean chroma keying.`

## 5-Pose Sprite Sheet: Cyber Kitsune — `sheet.png`
The 5-pose sprite sheet provides the full emotional suite for the chosen mascot (Concept 1 - Cyber Kitsune):
1. **Idle**: Upright standing, friendly warm smile, big shiny eyes.
2. **Working**: Focused and determined, busily typing on a tiny glowing azure holographic terminal / laptop.
3. **Success**: Celebrating with paws raised high, happy closed-arc eyes, sparkle stars around.
4. **Error**: Worried expression, sweat drop on brow, holding ears with dizzy / distressed eyes.
5. **Sleep**: Curled up peacefully asleep on a cyber-pillow with floating `z z Z`.

- **Prompt**:
  > `Generate a 5-pose sprite sheet in cute chibi pixel art style featuring the Cyber Kitsune robot fox mascot from Concept 1. Style and specs: High resolution cute chibi pixel art sprite style, clean 1px dark outline, crisp hard pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients. Character design: The same lovable robot fox with white face/belly, navy blue (#0A1A2F) and azure (#0B6BFF) armor, glowing amber (#FFB020) eyes, mechanical fox ears, fluffy cyber tail, and small glowing azure '<' chevron on chest badge. Sheet layout: 5 distinct poses arranged neatly side by side in a horizontal row on a single sheet: 1. Idle: standing upright, happy front-facing smile, shiny big eyes. 2. Working: focused and determined, typing busily on a tiny glowing azure holographic laptop / keyboard. 3. Success: jumping up in celebration, arms up, closed happy-arc eyes, sparkle stars around. 4. Error: worried / dizzy swirl eyes, sweat drop on brow, holding ears in mild panic. 5. Sleep: curled up asleep peacefully on a soft cyber-pillow, tiny 'z z Z' floating above. Background: Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background across the entire sheet for chroma keying.`

---

## Recommendation & Rationale

**Recommendation**: **Concept 1 (Cyber Kitsune / Robot Fox)**.

**Rationale**:
1. **Tech Identity & Agility**: The fox (kitsune) is a classic symbol of intelligence, quick problem-solving, and adaptability in developer tools. It bridges modern AI capabilities with the agile nature of coding agents.
2. **Distinctive Silhouette & Kawaii Proportions**: The triangular mechanical ears and large fluffy segmented tail create an immediately recognizable silhouette even at small sizes (16x16 or 32x32 favicon/badge scales).
3. **Natural Logo Integration**: The glowing azure `<` chevron fits seamlessly onto the chest collar badge as a sleek power core/emblem, directly reinforcing the OnniCode brand mark.
4. **Color Harmony & UI Contrast**: The combination of dark navy (`#0A1A2F`) armor, vibrant azure (`#0B6BFF`) and sky (`#5CA8FF`) accents, warm amber (`#FFB020`) eye sensors, and crisp white face plates ensures strong legibility against both dark and light cockpit themes.
5. **Expressive Range**: As demonstrated in `sheet.png`, the ears, tail, and amber eyes give the character immense emotive range across the key cockpit states (idle, working, success, error, sleep).
